backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with all user types, constants, and persistent maps for tasks, notes, timers, profiles, rewards, and focus data.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a migration routine that filters old user level data to remove invalid rank values.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping feature requests to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all major frontend components and utilities in the project.
frontend/index.css: Defines global OKLCH-based light and dark theme variables and base Tailwind styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets metadata, icons, and loads the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication flow, profile setup, tab navigation, and section rendering.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: UI for purchasing or uploading custom and AI‑generated backgrounds, managing costs, previews, and camera uploads.
frontend/src/components/DailyGoalProgres: Displays and edits the user's daily study goal and shows progress based on today's completed study sessions.
frontend/src/components/DailySyllabusRem: Checks daily syllabus progress and triggers a browser notification after 8 PM if nothing is completed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with branding and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the app header with theme toggle, authentication controls, and user avatar/profile menu.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Presents the login page with feature highlights and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyStudySumm: Displays study stats for a selected month, including total minutes and best 7‑day streak.
frontend/src/components/NoteLinker.tsx: Allows linking, unlinking, or creating notes to associate with another entity via dialogs.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Manages creating, editing, and deleting notes with support for images, voice recordings, and file handling. Uses query hooks and local state to upload blobs and maintain UI modals.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: Displays and updates the user profile, including bio, display name, profile image, coins, streaks, and level info. Handles image uploads, name changes, and level upgrade actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial profile setup dialog collecting name and optional bio. Submits data to the backend and displays a welcome message with awarded coins.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Schedules browser notifications for upcoming reminders and prevents duplicate alerts using session storage. Requests notification permissions and manages timer cleanup.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: Provides UI for creating, editing, and deleting reminders with optional linked notes. Validates input times and interacts with backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/RewardShopSectio: Renders a virtual shop where users can purchase cosmetic items with coins. Manages owned items, purchase dialogs, and balance validation.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Implements a persistent stopwatch UI synced with backend actor state, handling restore, start/pause, reset, and time formatting.
frontend/src/components/StudyHeatmapView: Renders a 90‑day study activity heatmap by computing daily session minutes and visual intensity levels.
frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerS: Provides a syllabus tracker with subjects, subtopics, exam countdown, local storage persistence, and editing dialogs.
frontend/src/components/TaskCompletionHe: Generates a 90‑day task completion heatmap by aggregating task completion counts and displaying weekly grids.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Implements Pomodoro and custom timers with session recording, streaks, coins, notifications, and integrated stopwatch view.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Checkbox to toggle whether a timetable entry is marked done for the current day.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog for updating a timetable entry’s title and activity type while showing read‑only schedule info.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog showing a timetable entry’s 6‑month completion history with stats and daily indicators.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: UI for listing, adding, editing, and deleting timetable entries with dialogs and time validation.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Task manager allowing creation, editing, completion toggling, deletion, and note linking for tasks.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyStudyTimeG: Displays aggregated weekly study session data using a stacked bar chart with summary stats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailySyllabusCheck: Tracks a daily syllabus checkoff count by reading and polling localStorage once per second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using Dfinity AuthClient.
Custom hook for persisting state to localStorage with safe parsing and optional numeric clamping.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, coins, and related backend data via an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Utility class for showing toast or browser notifications with fallbacks and permission handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that mounts React, sets up React Query, and wraps the app with the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to user‑friendly messages with fallbacks for unexpected errors.
frontend/src/utils/levelRanks.ts: Defines level rank constants and normalizes legacy rank strings.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Helpers to format dates and compare timestamps against today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and maps timetable ticks into day‑completion history for the last six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash-based routes), persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing them from the URL hash.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyStudyGraph.ts: Aggregates completed study sessions into a 7‑day dataset summarizing minutes by session type.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radius, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature scope, architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions for the app.
